panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Rivers of molten rock carve channels through the obsidian floor. At the chamber's heart, the Cinder Monarch rises from its throne of cooling magma — a creature of living flame wrapped in a shell of volcanic glass.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The heat is suffocating. Every breath burns. Within the Monarch's chest, you glimpse fragments of something crystalline — shards of the same corruption you've seen before, but here they glow white-hot with stolen power.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Cinder Monarch cracks like cooling glass, its inner fire guttering and dying. The lava rivers slow to a crawl, their surface darkening. For the first time, the chamber knows something approaching silence.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Three crystalline fragments tumble from the Monarch's remains, their glow fading but not extinguished. They hum with residual energy — fragments of something larger, something that was broken long ago. Or perhaps something that was broken deliberately.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Cinder Monarch's flames consume everything. The heroes are reduced to ash and memory, their equipment melting into the obsidian floor. The volcano has no mercy for the unprepared.
